data: Sunderesh Selvaraj is a Software Engineer working remotely for a Bangalore-based company, with four years of experience. Since 2023, he has been a Scrum Master, efficiently managing Agile processes. While not specializing in Adobe applications, he has developed extensions for Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop, gaining knowledge of their ecosystems. He has experience with Node.js and is actively working to strengthen his full-stack development skills. Additionally, he aims to gain cloud exposure by diving into AWS. Outside of work, he enjoys playing shuttle, cycling, traveling, and binge-watching anime and series, with bike riding being his true passion.
